sources.conclusion: large changes start with a plan; tasks should be well scoped; issue-like prompts and persistent repo context improve results
repository knowledge is the system of record; short AGENTS map; structured docs; mechanical checks; self-review plus additional agent reviews
use pro mode selectively for difficult high-value coding/review with clear evaluation criteria, required evidence and success criteria
terminal logs and test results are verifiable evidence; uncertainty/test failures must be surfaced
attestations establish build provenance and can be verified; they do not establish scientific correctness
